entities.name: Obsidian Equinox Marina & Docks
entities.source_summary: Exclusive marina used by wealthy yacht owners from the Exec Zone and Charter Hill, charging a substantial monthly berth fee.

entities.name: Pleasant Valley Apartments
entities.source_summary: Retro low-tech apartment building marketed to residents seeking pre-Collapse-style living; the source states that units continue to sell.
entities.catalogue_note: The source establishes a specific property development rather than fungible housing stock, so no generic property assortment is generated.

entities.name: Tanson Group Headquarters
entities.source_summary: Restricted Tanson administration, manufacturing, research and warehousing complex. Tanson goods have begun flowing from the site to other West Coast cities, but little is sent to Night City stores and no public showroom is described.

distribution.product_family: Tanson goods ranging from food to vehicles
distribution.service_area: other West Coast cities; minimal Night City retail

entities.name: WNS Offices
entities.source_summary: World News Service newsroom and local broadcast studio, paired with an adjacent music station where DMS talent scouts search for new performers to sign.
